criteria.requirement: Implement confuse.scopes.temporary_override(root,value), a synchronous context manager for RootView and mapping dict inputs. Deep-copy input, insert one independent ConfigSource at highest priority and yield it. On normal or exceptional exit remove only that exact source identity, preserving preexisting source identities/order, unrelated additions/removals and nested scopes even when dictionaries compare equal. Do not reset the whole source list or redactions and do not claim concurrent isolation.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
